name: s3m-maplibre
description: SuperMap S3M 三维模型格式的 MapLibre / Mapbox 原生渲染图层：浏览器内直接解析 .s3mb 瓦片，无需转 3D Tiles，支持多数据集叠加、白膜/按高度/按单体/动态扫描着色、单体级 GPU 拾取与属性查询。

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/build-docs.mjs
scripts.demo: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/serve.mjs
scripts.test:parse: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/parse-sample.mjs
scripts.test:meshopt: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/meshopt-check.mjs --preset shenyin
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/e2e.mjs
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/parse-sample.mjs && node tools/test-batch-texmatrix.mjs && node tools/test-texture-format.mjs && node tools/test-ortho.mjs && node tools/test-instanced.mjs && node tools/test-regressions.mjs && node tools/test-parser.mjs && node tools/test-new-features.mjs
scripts.test:texture: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/test-texture-format.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:regress: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/test-regressions.mjs
scripts.test:parser: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node tools/test-parser.mjs
